title: Sealed admin activity archive with HSM notarization and region-aware retention enforcement
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Deliver an append-only admin-activity archival pipeline that produces tamper-evident, region-tagged snapshots, notarizes each snapshot using an HSM-backed signing operation, and writes immutable bundles to provider-native WORM stores (S3 Object Lock / GCS Retention / Azure immutability). Goal: provide legally-defensible retention artifacts for admin actions (user role changes, RBAC grants, config updates, private deployment actions) that satisfy residency and legal-hold needs.
motivation: Customers in regulated industries require auditable evidence that admin events are captured immutably, retained according to per-region policy, and can be verified independently. Current exports are too mutable and lack cryptographic notarization for legal e-discovery. This work closes that gap and integrates into Console evidence workflows.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline produces daily and on-demand snapshots of admin events grouped by residency-region and retention-class
Each snapshot bundle contains an append-only event ledger, a manifest, and a cryptographic notarization (HSM ECDSA signature + SHA-256 Merkle root)
Bundles are written to customer-region WORM store with retention-lock metadata and verified object-lock headers (S3 Object Lock compliance mode or provider equivalent)
Console exposes evidence export entries with verification status and a download URL that includes the notarization file and a verification guide
CLI/SDK verifier can attest bundle integrity given public verification keys and confirms HSM timestamp provenance
Retention enforcement prevents programmatic deletion before expiry and supports legal-hold extension via Console API
End-to-end integration tests and a canary rollout plan validated in staging and dedicated environments
implementation_notes: Ingress: consume existing admin-event stream (Kafka topic: admin-events-v2) and augment with residency tags from account metadata
Ledger format: newline-delimited JSON events with header metadata including sequence ID, region, retention-class, and canonical timestamp
Snapshot creation: assemble daily shards (and manual snapshots for legal-hold) and compute Merkle tree across event bytes; record root in a compact manifest
Notarization: call HSM signing service (via KMS/HSM gateway) to sign the Merkle root + ISO8601 snapshot timestamp. Use ECDSA-P384 keys stored in HSM cluster with attestable key IDs
Storage: write zipped bundle (.tar.gz) containing ledger, manifest, signature, and verification README to region-specific buckets with object-lock/retention metadata set atomically

Verification: provide a small Go-based verifier in the repo that fetches bundle, validates object-lock metadata, recomputes Merkle root, and verifies ECDSA signature against published verification key
Backfill: create a backfill job for last 24 months of admin events for jurisdictions that require historical proof; backfill must be rate-limited and flagged
Monitoring: add metrics for snapshot success/failure, HSM latency, signing error rates, storage write failures, and verification failures (console evidence page shows these)
Failover: if HSM unavailable, mark snapshot as "unsigned" but still persist ledger with clear custody metadata and trigger escalation to SRE and on-call security
Privacy: redact PII fields for exports unless customer opts into full capture; record redaction map in manifest
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (staging): implement pipeline and verifier; run daily snapshots for internal test tenants for 2 weeks
Phase 2 (dedicated preview): enable feature for small set of Dedicated customers with opt-in and collect verification reports
Phase 3 (GA): enable on-hosted with per-account default retention driven by region policy and admin UI controls
Canary rules: snapshot success rate > 99% and signing latency < 2s for 99th percentile before expanding to more accounts
qa_criteria: Unit tests for Merkle root calculation and manifest generation
Integration test that performs HSM signing against a test KMS/HSM emulator and verifies signature
E2E test that writes to S3/GCS/Azure test buckets and asserts object-lock/retention metadata and immutability behavior
Chaos test: simulate intermittent HSM failure and assert correct unsigned snapshot handling and alerting
Verification regression harness: run verifier against archived bundles in staging and compare results to expected
security_notes: Key material never leaves HSM; signing requests go through authenticated gateway with mTLS and RBAC
Access to notarization keys gated by role; audit every signing request with context for later forensics
Manifest includes non-reversible event hashes to avoid creating new PII leakage vectors
Coordinate with Legal for retention classes and exportability for each region
